The year '''122 ABY''' was a span of [[Time/Legends|time]] that was most notable for the creation of the [[Ossus Project]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]'s efforts would be sabotaged by the [[One Sith]] during its conception, but the effects would not be seen for several years.

==Events==
*[[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] was [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] to its original terrain by the [[Shaper caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].<ref name="L0½">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0½|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0½]]</ref>
*The [[Ossus Project]] was initiated by the [[New Jedi Order]] to restore [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] devastated by the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], in which the Shaper caste of the Yuuzhan Vong attempted to restore their original terrains.<ref name="L0½" />
